ruleDefinitions.name: Potential SPN Enumeration Via Setspn.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects service principal name (SPN) enumeration used for Kerberoasting

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\setspn\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "setspn\.exe" OR (process_description = RGX(".*Query\\ or\\ reset\\ the\\ computer.*") AND process_description = RGX(".*SPN\\ attribute.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-q\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/q\\ .*")))
